entries: {DISASTER:strikes} tore through {place}, and the backup systems woke {first}.
{MESSAGE:physical} came from {SOMEONE:!plural} on the far side of {place}: open {landmark}.
The {rival} cut power to {landmark} {MANNER}, and {SOMEONE:!plural} woke in the dark.
{SOMEONE:!plural} docked at {place} {MANNER} {MANNER}: no flight plan, no pulse.
The ship's mind asked {first} {MANNER} for help with {TOPIC}.
{first} decoded the static from {landmark}, and it was the name of {CLOSE:human}.
